dct_description_sm: Feel free to contact me if you have any questions or require any additional information about the dataset.

This dataset is a series of .csv files with the zonal statistics for the various areas described in Bogue et al., 2023. Full citation will be added upon publication. All information about how these statistics were calculated and where the various areas are can be found in the manuscript.
dct_title_s: Tern Lake thermal area Landsat NDVI data
